LESSON: READING 9.2.1 GRADE- APPROPRIATE FICTION MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.2: Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to read fictional materials?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read fictional texts for information and enjoyment
2. appreciate the importance of fiction in life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 9.2.1 GRADE- APPROPRIATE FICTION MATERIALS
This lesson teaches Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. read fictional texts for information and enjoyment
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the importance of fiction in life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials above.
2. Explain Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to read fictional materials?
2. What should you consider when selecting fictional texts for reading?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read fictional texts for information and enjoyment
2. appreciate the importance of fiction in life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
